# R016 — State formation takes effect on 1 November 1956

Sections 2(a) and 5 make 1 November 1956 the appointed day for formation of the new state. Section 5 combines specified territories and contains explicit exclusions.

**Evidence type:** `primary_legislation`  
**Geographic relation:** `core`  
**Places:** Territories specified in section 5
